title: Miracle of Fatima mass sighting

tellings.quote: the miracle of Fatima. You know, there was 50,000 people or 70,000 or whatever it was.
And the clouds part and there's this thing in the sky and the sources that we have from lawyers and doctors and you know very serious people describe it as a silvery disc.
tellings.difference: Describes the object as a silvery disc, cites lawyers and doctors as sources, and puts the crowd at 70,000.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about the 1917 Fatima mass sighting witnessed by tens of thousands.

as_told.title: Fatima miracle: silvery disc seen by 70,000

tellings.quote: hear of a story like you know Fatima you know Portugal like 1917 you know these three orphans get this sort of you know prophecy that uh you know the Virgin Mary is going to come and then these lights in the sky appear among like 100 plus people or whatever

tellings.link_reason: The same 1917 Fatima mass sighting of lights in the sky.

as_told.title: Fatima 1917: prophecy and lights in the sky seen by a crowd

plain: In 1917 in Fatima, Portugal, a huge crowd is said to have seen something strange in the sky. Michels tells it as three orphans being given a prophecy that the Virgin Mary would come, and then lights appearing in the sky in front of a hundred or more people. The researcher Jason Simosa says the clouds parted and a thing appeared that lawyers, doctors and other serious witnesses described as a silvery disc. The skeptic Michael Shermer mentions it in passing as the Miracle of Fatima, with a crowd of 50,000 or 70,000. People bring it up because, if true, it would be a religious miracle seen by many people at once that sounds a lot like a UFO.
